#   https://github.com/Berkeley-Electroweak-Physics/Elastic, with the polynomial parametrization of
#   arXiv:1308.6288v1.

# F_{O1,O2}^{tau1,tau2}(E_R) = 16 pi / (2 j_N + 1) * exp(-2y) * sum_{k=0}^{10} a_k y^k,  y = (q b / 2)^2,
#   q^2 = 2 m_T E_R, with b^2 the harmonic-oscillator length squared of the nucleus (B2 in
#   lib/source/effFormFact.c), m_T the mass of the nucleus (A, Z) and j_N its spin. Isospin basis:
#   tau1, tau2 = +, - (+- = (p +- n) / 2).
# Responses (O1, O2): M = M, Sp = Sigma', Spp = Sigma'', D = Delta, Ppp = Phi'', Pp = Phi', Pt (Pp and Pt
#   enter O_12 and O_15 as Pp + Pt); O1 != O2 are the interferences (M-Ppp, Sp-D).
# Lookup: the row with the same A, Z, O1, O2 and nucleon labels (each row appears once); a response
